old_description: Amaral Custom Fabrications is a family owned and operated company with a rich, 20-year history. We are versatile fabricators who are able to apply our technical know-how to many industries, including large-scale sculpture and art fabrication, marine and architectural trades, and sculpture restorations, among many, many others.
about:
Amaral Custom Fabrications Inc operates from Rumford, Rhode Island, as a family-owned and operated business with a 20-year history. The founding year and founder names are not publicly disclosed.

The shop specializes in hand-fabricated sculpture using marine-grade and aerospace-grade materials and techniques. Its capabilities span large-scale sculpture and art fabrication, marine and architectural metalwork, and sculpture restoration. No facility size, headcount, or production volumes are published.

Clients come from the fine art, marine, architectural, and cultural heritage sectors. Projects include large-scale public sculptures, marine components, architectural metal elements, and restoration of existing artworks.

The company emphasizes its versatility in applying technical fabrication knowledge across diverse industries and its commitment to producing sculpture intended to last for generations.
